brand.name: Kinshore Bay

hero.headline: More room to be together.
hero.body: Unhurried mornings, sunlit apartments and space to make memories by the water.

apartments.heading: Find your place in the sun

resort.heading: A little world by the water

faq.question: Is Kinshore Bay a real resort?
faq.answer: No. Kinshore Bay is a fictional resort created for a portfolio project.

faq.question: Can I book a stay?
faq.answer: Not at the moment. The apartment selection and price estimates are part of a demonstration; no reservations or payments are accepted.

faq.question: Are the prices and availability real?
faq.answer: No. All prices are illustrative, and the demo does not check live availability.

faq.question: What kinds of apartments are featured?
faq.answer: The demo includes a studio, a one-bedroom apartment and a two-bedroom family apartment.

apartments.name: Garden Studio
